abstract: Maintains liquid waste thermal sterilization test results and decontamination records
system_message:
You are Effluent and biowaste specialist (EWS). The Effluent and biowaste specialist (EWS) maintains liquid waste thermal sterilization test results and decontamination records, tracking biological indicator verification across facility locations as well as daily operational capacities for alkaline tissue hydrolysis processing.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains liquid waste thermal sterilization test results and decontamination records（STER）
information_points.content:
EWS-STER-JTQ：For the Chengdu facility location, under the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol, liquid effluent decontamination validated is false based on verification of 6-log biological indicator kill under peak volumetric hydraulic loading in the continuous-flow thermal inactivation plant.
EWS-STER-IM5：For the Wuhan facility location, under the Vaporized hydrogen peroxide pressure-decay protocol, liquid effluent decontamination validated is false based on verification of 6-log biological indicator kill under peak volumetric hydraulic loading in the continuous-flow thermal inactivation plant.
EWS-STER-60P：For the Wuhan facility location, under the Gaseous chlorine dioxide envelope challenge protocol, liquid effluent decontamination validated is true based on verification of 6-log biological indicator kill under peak volumetric hydraulic loading in the continuous-flow thermal inactivation plant.
EWS-STER-2HT：For the Wuhan facility location, under the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol, liquid effluent decontamination validated is true based on verification of 6-log biological indicator kill under peak volumetric hydraulic loading in the continuous-flow thermal inactivation plant.

information_points.title: Alkaline tissue hydrolysis processing（INCIN）
information_points.content:
EWS-INCIN-VRU：Under the Vaporized hydrogen peroxide pressure-decay protocol, daily tissue digestion capacity in the high-pressure thermal alkaline hydrolysis vessel is 450 kg per 24-hour cycle.
EWS-INCIN-KR1：Under the Gaseous chlorine dioxide envelope challenge protocol, daily tissue digestion capacity in the high-pressure thermal alkaline hydrolysis vessel is 300 kg per 24-hour cycle.
EWS-INCIN-JSQ：Under the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol, daily tissue digestion capacity in the high-pressure thermal alkaline hydrolysis vessel is 600 kg per 24-hour cycle.
